annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because the speaker promotes paid cryptocurrency packages with multi-generation network bonuses and specific weekly earnings tied to package levels and organizational membership. The presentation claims token balances can exceed the package price, shows token-growth projections and package prices, and urges viewers to purchase, contact the group, and take an early position for profit through a registration link and invitation to join Singular Group. The projected returns and related claims are presented as promotions rather than established results.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The promoted earnings structure depends on network legs, members on both sides and qualifying package tiers, alongside a package-conditioned weekly earnings example. Priced packages are paired with token quantities; the speaker also suggests buying more tokens or holding them for a better sale price and claims package-linked splits could exceed the package price.
